d:
When love is in the air, every heartbeat has a melody! Enjoy “Dil Tera Deewana Hai” from the 1995 Bollywood film Raghuveer, featuring Suniel Shetty and Shilpa Shirodkar. Beautifully sung by Kumar Sanu and Poornima, this romantic duet brings back the musical charm of 90s Bollywood.

Song: Dil Tera Deewana Hai
Movie: Raghuveer (1995)
Star Cast: Sunil Shetty & Shilpa Shirodkar
Singers: Kumar Sanu, Poornima
Music Director: Dilip Sen and Sameer Sen
Lyricist: Sameer
